mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a crisp overnight low of 47 degrees, with no rain expected through the night under the waning crescent moon.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted Envision Verona, a comprehensive plan shaped by years of community feedback that will serve as a roadmap for infrastructure, neighborhood development, and sustainability for the next decade.

We have a busy lineup today including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee.

In a noteworthy incident from October 3, Verona Police arrested a 19-year-old man who was found to be a felon in possession of a stolen firearm after an officer initiated a traffic stop for expired registration.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Turtle Cheesecake, and with the store open until 10:00 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by for a treat before the doors close for the night.
